items.title: 8.11.1 Le Chatelier ke usool ke istemalat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.11.1, printed page 179.

blocks.text: Physical aur chemical equilibria par is principle ke sab se aam istemal (applications) yeh hain, jo agle topics mein parhenge:

blocks.alt: Hamara apna khaaka: chaar rangeen khaane. Concentration: reactant barhayein ya product hatayein to equilibrium aage jata hai. Dabao: dabao barhayein to equilibrium gas ke kam moles wali taraf jata hai. Darja hararat: garmi dein to endothermic taraf; sirf yahi Kc badalta hai. Catalyst: equilibrium jaldi aata hai, position aur Kc nahi badalte.
blocks.caption: Le Chatelier ke usool ke chaar istemalat ek nazar mein (hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh khaaka nahi).
blocks.long_description: Reactant shamil karna ya product hatana equilibrium ko daen dhakelta hai; product shamil karna ya reactant hatana baen. Dabao barhana kam gas molecules wali taraf ko tarjeeh deta hai. Darja hararat barhana endothermic simt ko tarjeeh deta hai, to garam karna exothermic SO3 banne ka Kc ghatata aur endothermic N2O4 tootne ka barhata hai. Catalyst dono activation rukawatein barabar ghata kar wahi equilibrium jaldi pata hai. Sirf darja hararat khud Kc badalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa akela factor equilibrium constant ki value badalta hai, aur baqi factors kya badalte hain?
blocks.explanation: Sirf temperature Kc badalta hai. Concentration, pressure ya volume badalne se sirf equilibrium ki position (mixture ka tanasub) badalti hai, Kc wahi rehta hai. Catalyst na position badalta hai na Kc; sirf equilibrium jaldi aata hai.

items: Chaar applications: concentration (8.12), pressure ya volume (8.13), temperature (8.14), catalyst (8.15).
